create.title: B1 pair-energy capacity and off-diagonal no-go
create.statement_tex: Assume the exact reduced-fraction support and B1. Then ||A_chi||_1 << D log(2H), ||A_chi||_2^2 << D, and for R_chi=A_chi*A_chi the divisor identity gives sum_r |R_chi(r)|^2 <<_epsilon D^2 X^epsilon. Rational spacing yields only the smoothed global capacity D^2 X^epsilon(1+D^4/X). Moreover, an even odd-numerator exact-support envelope model has normalized critical fat-band mass >> D^3/X-O_epsilon(X^epsilon), so B1 alone cannot imply c_chi << X^epsilon by a power for D>=X^(1/3+delta). This does not refute the actual chi_4 lift system.
create.next_action: Use this as a scope barrier: the next proof must establish an actual chi_4-structured off-diagonal autocorrelation theorem and must fail on the envelope adversary. Keep the global-moment to pointwise bridge separate.

update.statement_tex: For A_chi(p/q)=sum_{gq in [D,2D), 1<=|gp|<=H} beta_{gp,H}w_D(gq), even p gives A_chi=0. For odd p, if the sampled odd-lift sequence has uniformly bounded chi_4-twisted discrepancy, in particular if w_D is a fixed scale-normalized BV profile or has uniform restricted-lattice BV norm, then |A_chi(p/q)| <= C/(pi|p|) min(1,q/D) <= Cq/(pi D|p|). Boundedness or unnormalized smoothness alone is insufficient. This is an individual pair-weight lemma only.
update.reason_for_promotion: Independent Abel-summation derivations agree after the exact odd-lift interval, parity, truncation, Phi monotonicity, and uniform twisted-discrepancy/BV hypotheses are stated. Hostile examples refute only the broader bounded-weight wording.
update.next_action: Apply B1 only after the actual block profile has a verified uniform scaled-BV or twisted-discrepancy norm. Do not infer off-diagonal energy cancellation from the pointwise envelope.

update.statement_tex: Specify every actual M2 denominator profile and endpoint rule. For a weighted W-1 obstruction require support in a fixed shell, H_D>=1, and sum_d |w_D(d)|>=lambda D. For B1 applications require a uniform scale-normalized BV or restricted-lattice twisted-discrepancy bound. Endpoint-truncated blocks must be merged, excluded, or verified separately.
update.next_action: Write the actual fixed dyadic profiles and endpoint truncation/merging rule, then verify both sampled l1 nondegeneracy and uniform scaled BV block by block.

update.statement_tex: For the actual reduced-fraction lift coefficients set R_chi(r)=sum_{x+y=r}A_chi(x)A_chi(y). With K the Fourier transform of a fixed smooth global weight, define c_chi^V(D;X)=D^(-2) Re sum_{r not equal s} R_chi(r) conjugate(R_chi(s)) K(X(r-s)/4). Prove |c_chi^V(D;X)| <<_epsilon X^epsilon, with a graded tail or full off-diagonal estimate, at least in the sign-critical range D>=X^(1/3+delta). B1 alone is insufficient, and this global statement does not imply pointwise M9-M2 without a separate large-value or direct bridge.
update.next_action: Prove the actual chi_4-structured off-diagonal autocorrelation bound for the critical band or full graded kernel. Start with the generic single-lift region q asymp D, where B1 is sharp and complementary numerator classes must provide cancellation.

Exploit the actual chi_4-generated correlation across numerator and denominator classes in the generic q asymp D band. B1 already uses lift-index alternation on small q but is character-blind at the energy step.

update.statement_tex: A coefficient-weighted near-collision estimate for 0<|N|~T that preserves the actual M2 chi_4 signs and is strong enough for the endpoint. Character-blind absolute control is power-obstructed for D>=X^(1/3+delta); the exact crossover D=X^(1/3) is not itself a contradiction.
update.next_action: Decompose the actual reduced-fraction support into many-lift and generic single-lift regions. Use B1 only for the former; for q asymp D prove a sign-sensitive autocorrelation or two-shift reciprocal-phase estimate.

Use the exact two-shift map H=L, M=D, T=X/4, F_rho(u)=u^(-1)+rho D/X. Quantify the smaller frequency blocks covered by Li-Yang and isolate the top block L asymp D X^(-1/4), which misses Case A by X^(2/41) and is excluded from Case B.

Preserve the exact rho=1,3 phase difference through any transform. Supply a full smooth stationary-phase formula and a post-transform signed estimate for the top frequency block rather than importing an inapplicable height-range theorem.

Complete the source card from the rendered primary PDF, including all Case A/B hypotheses and auxiliary parameters. The exact M2 phase map and top-height non-applicability are already recorded, but no theorem dependency is licensed.

reject.reason: Arbitrary bounded, and even smooth but unnormalized, weights can match chi_4 on an active lift progression and make A_chi(1/q) of order one while q/D tends to zero.
An exact-support even odd-numerator envelope model satisfies B1 but has normalized critical fat-band size of order D^3/X above the X^(1/3) crossover.
The accepted derivative propagation from a global fourth moment yields only D^(3/5)X^(3/20+epsilon), which is X^(9/20+epsilon) at D=X^(1/2).

no_change.reason: No actual signed off-diagonal theorem or pointwise endpoint estimate was proved.
Both reciprocal main sums are not uniformly closed.
The top frequency and pointwise endpoint gaps remain open.
The final theorem remains conditional on open M9.

round_assessment.reason: Round 3 proves the exact B1 lemma under sharp hypotheses, derives the exact signed global normalization and a D^2 X^epsilon pair-energy bound, and rigorously shows that the B1 envelope cannot supply the needed upper-range off-diagonal cancellation. It identifies the actual chi_4 autocorrelation and top-height two-shift block as the next interface without promoting M9-M2.
